content.title: How to watch Cardinals vs. Astros: TV channel and streaming options for April 19
content.text: The Houston Astros will look for continued production from a slugger on a hot streak against the St. Louis Cardinals on Sunday at 2:10 p.m. ET, at Daikin Park. Yordan Alvarez is currently on a two-game homer streak. Mike Burrows (1-3, 6.55 ERA) gets the start for the Astros, who are 8-14 this season and fifth in the AL West. Matthew Liberatore (0-1, 4.29 ERA) is starting for the Cardinals, who are 12-8 and third in the NL Central.How to watch St. Louis Cardinals vs. Houston Astros Venue: Daikin Park Time: 2:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: SCHN and Cardinals.TV Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. He has an 11.1% strikeout rate and a 19.2% walk rate in 99 plate appearances, and he has scored 18 total runs. In 88 plate appearances, Christian Walker has hit four long balls, tallied 16 RBIs (16th in MLB) and scored 12 runs. He is batting .263/.352/.500 and has posted a 17% strikeout rate and an 11.4% walk rate. Jordan Walker has hit eight home runs this season, which ranks 2nd in MLB. He has also tallied 16 RBIs (16th in MLB) and has scored 16 runs. In 85 plate appearances, he has recorded a .312 BA, .376 OBP and .662 SLG with a 9.4% walk rate and a 29.4% strikeout rate. He has been effective on the base paths, recording three steals on three attempts. In 90 plate appearances, Alec Burleson has slashed .299/.389/.481 this season. He has hit three long balls and driven in 15 runs with a strikeout rate of 10% and a walk rate of 13.3%. and has scored nine runs.
